name: Arcana Twilight
source:
A day when the sky comes tumbling down, and the stars are falling. When the signs of disaster open their eyes, you will be talking about us.

Welcome back, this is the end of the world. Bound Arlyn, a place looked after by the constellation.

Take a good look. See for yourself what a ragged world this is.

[Edited from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.storytaco.skytellers.romance.anime.otome.magic.battle]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
当天空崩塌，繁星坠落，灾厄的征兆睁开双眼之时，你将谈起我们的故事。

欢迎回来。这里是世界的尽头——邦德阿林，受星座庇佑之地。

好好看看吧。亲眼见证，这是一个多么残破的世界。

[编译自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.storytaco.skytellers.romance.anime.otome.magic.battle]Google Play[/url]]
